notes: Live research diagnostic set. `expect` is legacy keyword diagnostics only and never establishes correctness. Factual rules require independently reviewed `requiredFacts` (each phrase or alternatives list must match) and optional `forbiddenFacts`; current questions also require `goldAsOf` to match today's UTC date. Otherwise factual scoring is null and requires manual review. Citation validity, numeric support, retrieval, abstention and factual rules are separate dimensions. Numeric/citation checks do not certify semantic entailment. `kind` groups fact, number, recent, howto, local, ambiguous, multihop, url, pdf and none. Adversarial regression fixtures live in research_adversarial.json.
